Clamps the final image to the [0, 1] range.\n\nPrevents overshoot artifacts such as bright halos or negative colors.\nRecommended for LDR pipelines; optional for HDR depending on tone-mapping.\n\nWhen not set OptiScaler controls it via upscalers HDR flag = 将合成后的最终画面色彩强制钳位在 [0, 1] 标准区间。\n\n可有效消除锐化算法产生的过度过冲白色亮边或负色反常伪影。\n强烈建议在标准动态范围(SDR)下开启；HDR 模式下视色调映射而定。\n\n未手动指定时，OptiScaler 将根据超分辨率的 HDR 标志位自动接管。

Controls how strongly sharpening is reduced across depth edges.\n\nHigher values more aggressively prevent sharpening across object boundaries (reduces halos).\nLower values allow more sharpening to pass across edges (sharper but riskier). = 控制在深度突变边缘（物体与背景分界线）处降低锐化强度的剧烈程度。\n\n较高数值会更强力地抑制物体轮廓边缘的锐化，极大减少亮白光晕；\n较低数值允许锐化穿透物体边缘，画面更锐利但更容易出现白边。
Controls sharpness at high contrast areas. = 控制在明暗强烈对比区域（如灯光、窗框）的局部锐化强度。
Controls the DXGI Present sync interval, which determines how\nthe swap chain waits for vertical refresh.\n\n0  \= Present immediately, no VSync wait.\n1  \= Sync to every refresh, normal VSync.\n2+ \= Present every N refreshes, reducing effective frame rate.\n\nHigher values can reduce tearing but may increase latency and cap FPS.\nFor most games, use 0 for lowest latency or 1 for normal VSync. = 控制 DXGI Present 呈现同步间隔，决定交换链如何\n等待显示器的垂直刷新信号。\n\n0  \= 立即呈现，不等待垂直同步（最低延迟，可能撕裂）。\n1  \= 同步到每一次刷新，即标准垂直同步。\n2+ \= 每隔 N 次垂直刷新才呈现一次画面，成倍压低帧率。\n\n较高数值可杜绝画面撕裂但会增加操作延迟并锁定帧率。\n绝大多数游戏建议选 0 以追求最低延迟，或选 1 保证画面平滑无撕裂。
Converts depth distances into the units of the camera position\nso the cache can follow the camera when you walk.\n0 \= only follow rotation\nWrong values make the cache fill wobble while walking\nAlso used by the 3rd person detection\nUnreal Engine is usually around 1000 = 将深度距离转换为镜头坐标系单位，\n使重投影缓存能在玩家走动时跟随摄像机移动。\n0 \= 仅跟随镜头旋转\n数值错误会导致走动时边缘补帧出现果冻晃动\n该值也用于第三人称视角检测\n虚幻引擎游戏通常在 1000 左右

Corresponds to amount of accumulation added per frame\nat pixel coordinate where disocclusion occured or when\nreactive mask value is > 0.0f. Decreasing this and \ndrawing the ghosting object (IE no mv) to reactive mask \nwith value close to 1.0f can decrease temporal ghosting.\nDecreasing this could result in more thin feature pixels flickering. = 对应在发生遮挡剔除或响应遮罩值 > 0.0 时，\n像素坐标每帧新增的时域累积量。降低此值并将\n残影物体写入响应遮罩可减少鬼影拖尾；\n但过低可能导致细小几何边缘闪烁。

Defines the motion range over which the effect ramps from zero to full strength.\n\nValues above the threshold are mapped into this range.\nLarger values make the response smoother and more gradual.\nSmaller values make the effect react more quickly and aggressively. = 定义动态锐化从零强度平滑爬升到全开强度的运动速度动态区间。\n\n超出阈值的运动矢量将被映射到该区间内。\n较大数值使过渡更丝滑自然；\n较小数值使锐化对细微动作的反应更迅猛激进。

Ignores small depth differences before edge detection.\n\nHigher values reduce flickering and noise from minor depth changes, but may soften real geometry edges.\nLower values preserve fine detail but can cause unstable or noisy edge detection. = 在执行轮廓识别前忽略微小的深度起伏。\n\n较高数值可减少起伏表面上的噪点闪烁，但可能轻度软化真实几何边缘；\n较低数值完整保留细微几何反差，但可能导致复杂纹理表面产生颗粒噪点。

Maximum amount of sharpness that motion can add or remove.\n\nNegative values reduce sharpening in motion (recommended).\nPositive values increase sharpening in motion.\n\nThe final adjustment scales with motion and is capped at this value. = 运动状态下允许调整的最大锐度极值。\n\n负数：镜头转动时主动降低锐度（强烈推荐，可消灭运动噪点）；\n正数：镜头转动时进一步激进加锐；\n\n最终调节量随速度动态线性插值，最高不会突破该绝对值上限。
Meant for development purpose to test if\nwriting a larger value to reactive mask, reduces ghosting. = 面向开发调试，用于测试\n向响应遮罩写入更大数值能否减少鬼影拖尾。

Reads the mouse right when the GPU starts the reprojection\ninstead of when the frame is presented on the CPU.\nLowers latency, especially when GPU bound = 在 GPU 即将开始重投影着色的一瞬间才读取最新鼠标坐标，\n而非在 CPU 呈现帧的早期阶段。\n可大幅压降输入延迟，在显卡满载瓶颈时效果尤为显著。

Relaxed Resource Check = 放宽资源匹配校验
Remembers what was around the camera in previous frames\nand uses it to fill the screen edges and the area under your hands.\nEdge fill mode is only used where the cache has nothing.\nShown with a blue tint in debug mode = 记录前几帧镜头周围的历史画面信息，\n用于补全视线快速转动时屏幕边缘暴露出未知空白区及手臂下方盲区。\n仅在历史缓存未覆盖的死角才会启用边缘拉伸补色。\n在调试模式中以蓝色调直观显示。

Reprojection (WIP) = 画面重投影 (开发中)
Reprojection Settings = 重投影设置
Reprojection would swing the character around with the camera,\nso it gets paused while something in the middle of the screen follows the camera.\nUses the game's motion vectors and the cache parallax scale.\nVehicle cockpits can count as 3rd person too.\nDisable to keep reprojection always active = 在第三人称下重投影会导致主角身体随镜头旋转发生诡异撕扯，\n因此当检测到屏幕中央有物体固定跟随镜头时算法会自动休眠。\n载具座舱有时也会被视作第三人称。\n关闭此项可保持重投影强制常开。
Reprojects the game image using new mouse data\nKinda like Reflex 2, perceived latency improvement\n\n- REQUIRES DLSSG VIA STREAMLINE AS INPUT\n- Only works with first person perspective games\n- Only mouse, no controller\n- If possible, disable any mouse/camera smoothing in the game\n = 使用最新的鼠标即时输入数据在渲染管线尾部重新投影游戏画面\n类似于下一代 Reflex 2 技术，带来肉眼可见的操作跟手度爆发式提升\n\n- 必须以“通过 Streamline 的 DLSSG”作为输入源\n- 目前仅适用于第一人称视角射击/动作游戏\n- 仅支持物理鼠标，暂不支持手柄摇杆\n- 建议在游戏内关闭任何鼠标平滑与相机滤波\n
Required for Debug flags to work correctly = 调试标志位正常解析并生效所必需的前置依赖项

Select the input color space that the game uses.\nNon-Linear / sRGB: Might improve FSR4 upscaling quality, might increase ghosting.\nPQ: Rarest, might increase ghosting and break lights. = 选择游戏所使用的输入色彩空间。\n非线性 / sRGB：可能提升 FSR4 重建画质，但也可能加重鬼影。\nPQ：最罕见，可能导致拖尾并在高光场景出现破损。
Select the sharpening filter to apply.\n\nUpscaler's default: Uses the sharpening provided by the upscaler.\nRCAS: AMD's RCAS, modified for Contrast and MAS.\nDepth Aware: Smarter sharpening with fewer artifacts (heavier).\n\nBy default uses a sharpening value provided by the game.\nSelect 'Override' under 'Sharpness' and adjust the slider to change it. = 选择要应用的图像锐化算法内核。\n\n超分辨率默认：直接使用超分算法自带的默认锐化通道；\nRCAS：AMD 官方经典的鲁棒对比度自适应锐化，支持扩展对比度与运动感知；\n深度感知(DA)：利用三维深度几何体智能规避白边伪影的顶级锐化方案（算力开销较高）。\n\n默认状态下沿用游戏自身在画质菜单里下发的锐化强度；\n若要手动微调，请在“锐化强度”下方勾选“强制覆盖”后拖动滑块自定义。
Selects how many elements close to the camera\nshould be shown over the reprojected image.\nThis prevents your gun from being moved in weird ways.\n\nUse "Show static elements" to help you adjust it\nUnreal Engine games are usually around 0.10\nCyberpunk is around 0.02 = 选择在重投影画面上保留多少靠近镜头的元素，\n以避免枪械等物体发生异常位移。\n\n可使用“显示静态元素”辅助调整。\n虚幻引擎游戏通常约为 0.10，\n赛博朋克约为 0.02。
Selects how many elements close to the camera\nshould be shown over the reprojected image.\nThis prevents your gun from being moved in weird ways.\n\nUse \"Show static elements\" to help you adjust it\nUnreal Engine games are usually around 0.10\nCyberpunk is around 0.02 = 选择在重投影画面上方保留多少贴近镜头的近景物体层。\n可防止你手中的枪械在快速转动时发生奇怪的错位形变。\n\n可借助“显示静态近景元素”高亮区域辅助校准\n虚幻引擎游戏通常推荐在 0.10 左右\n《赛博朋克 2077》推荐在 0.02 左右

Soft edge = 柔和边缘羽化填充
Soft edge and strech fill the screen edges with the edge pixels,\nsoft edge blurs them more the further out it goes\nDither and noise use the unprojected image as fill\nand then some blending on the edges to fool the eye = “柔化边缘”和“拉伸边缘”会使用画面边界像素来填补屏幕边缘空白，\n柔化边缘越靠近外侧模糊程度越高；\n“抖动”与“噪声”则取用未经重投影的原始画面作为基底，\n随后在接缝处进行视觉混色以欺骗人眼。
Some Unreal Engine games need this\n\nTry using if colours flickering or\nobjects have ghosting trails = 某些虚幻引擎游戏需要勾选此项\n\n若遇到画面色彩频闪或移动物体身后留下严重彩色鬼影，建议开启尝试

Upscaler's default = 超分辨率默认锐化
Upscalers = 超分方案
Upscales the image internally to a higher output resolution\nthen downscales it back to your display resolution\n\nValues <1.0 make the upscaler cheaper\nValues >1.0 make image sharper at the cost of performance\n\nIf greyed out, please check Git Wiki - Unreal Engine tweaks\n\nTarget res and total ratio at the bottom (max. total 3.0!) = 先在内部将画面超分重建到更高分辨率，\n再将其下采样回屏幕显示分辨率（DSR/动态超分辨率机制）。\n\n数值 <1.0 降低 GPU 负载提升流畅度\n数值 >1.0 显著提高锐度与清晰度但消耗性能\n\n若显示为灰色不可选，请查阅 Git Wiki 了解虚幻引擎修复技巧\n\n底部显示最终目标分辨率与总倍率（总倍率上限为 3.0！）

Use height difference as offset = 使用高度差作为采样偏移
Use if FSR4-FG is supported, otherwise stick to Enabler\n\nFFX used for the middle fake frame, Enabler for the rest\n\n2x - FFX\n3x - Enabler\n4x - FFX + Enabler\n5x - Enabler\n6x - FFX + Enabler\n\nDue to pacing, only odd number of fake frames are able to use FFX = 如果显卡支持 FSR4-FG 则推荐使用，否则建议维持 Enabler\n\nFFX 用于生成正中央的一帧，其余虚拟帧由 Enabler 补齐\n\n2x - 纯 FFX\n3x - 纯 Enabler\n4x - FFX + Enabler\n5x - 纯 Enabler\n6x - FFX + Enabler\n\n受帧平滑机制制约，仅有奇数个生成帧才能启用 FFX 介入
Use mutex to prevent desync of FG and crashes\nDisabling might improve the perf but decrease stability = 使用互斥锁防止帧生成管线不同步与游戏偶发崩溃\n禁用此项可能轻微提高帧率，但会显著降低运行稳定性
Use the UI texture the game blends on the frame in its last compute pass = 使用游戏在最终计算通道中混合到画面上的界面纹理
Uses Reflex when possible\nOn AMD/Intel cards, you can use Fakenvapi to substitute Reflex = 在支持的环境下优先调用 Reflex\n在 AMD / Intel 显卡上，可配合 Fakenvapi 伪装环境将 Reflex 转译调用
Uses frametimes calculated by Opti = 使用 OptiScaler 自主计算的高精度帧生成时间
Uses frametimes provided by\nDLSSG or FSR-FG = 直接采纳 DLSS 帧生成或 FSR 帧生成官方传递的基准帧生成时间
Using Reflex's limit with FSR FG has performance overhead = 配合 FSR 帧生成使用 Reflex 帧率限制会产生性能开销
Using a subset of features from DLSS Enabler = 使用 DLSS Enabler 的部分功能

Value of 0.0f can improve temporal stability of bright pixels\nLower values are more stable with ghosting\nHigher values are more pixelly, but less ghosting = 设为 0.0 可改善高亮像素的时域稳定性\n较低数值抗鬼影表现更平稳\n较高数值颗粒感更明显，但能大幅抑制拖尾
